entry.content: Earlier this year, we announced the Agentic Shopping Assistant on AWS, a generative AI-powered solution that helps retailers give online shoppers the kind of expert guidance they would get from a knowledgeable in-store associate. The Agentic Shopping Assistant on AWS brings the expertise and insights behind Amazon's successful Alexa for Shopping AI assistant to retail customers.
